page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-dense server instance configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

A defining attribute of the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge instance is its bundled local storage capacity of 94,489 GB utilizing hard disk drives (HDD). Network connectivity is supported by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth on a KVM hypervisor infrastructure, offering substantial network throughput to support large volumes of data ingress and egress.

The primary operational tradeoff stems from the storage medium. While the 94.4 TB HDD array delivers high raw storage density and cost efficiency for vast datasets, mechanical disk access speeds present distinct latency tradeoffs compared to solid-state drives. Performance benchmark measurements are currently unavailable for this instance type.

This instance configuration is suitable for workload fits requiring extensive local storage capacity coupled with moderate compute and memory capacity, such as big data storage clusters, distributed file systems, log analytics, continuous data ingestion, and bulk data archives.
